from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UndistributedProfitRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's undistributed profit equivalent figure for the specified period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company filing the report")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line-item label found (e.g. 'Retained Earnings', 'Accumulated Deficit')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported balance as a signed float")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the reported amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report covers (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    undistributed_profit_records: list[UndistributedProfitRecord]
